Settled by YTD-103 (ruling: "anti-blocking is a separate opt-in", whose Why names "the downloader and its anti-blocking parts") and page-07 7.4 ("those measures touch YouTube's terms, which is a choice the studio should make knowingly").
youtube F2 | instead | dashboard-2's "Every setting of the site" says it lists the core's site settings and that each part's own site settings are given, with their names and search words, in that part's piece; it drops its copies of youtube's settings (see youtube F1, F3). youtube's "The server's YouTube session" and "Periodic YouTube test" stay in youtube. Settled by OWNER_REQUIREMENTS 1 ("one place a setting comes from").
youtube F3 | home youtube | youtube's setting line and search words win; dashboard-2 points to it (youtube F2).
youtube F4 | instead | Not for the owner: releases-and-updates drops this refusal together with every "about ten seconds", as ruled on server-install-and-running-1 F14 (SRV-042, ruling: an update keeps the dashboard answering "with no gap a person or an editor's app can notice"); what a restart of the server does to a job is youtube's "A server restart never loses a job", which releases-and-updates points to.
